feeding_claim.verbatim: Raised on pasture, our chickens are allowed to roam, eating a natural diet of grasses, seeds, and insects.

notes: Family farm in Coggon, eastern Iowa; owners not named. Read homepage, practices, products and contact pages (WebFetch summaries only, so recheck the verbatim quote); the Barn2Door shop was not read. Practices page: pastured broilers, turkeys raised outdoors, pasture-raised eggs, outdoor-raised pork, and lamb described as grass-fed and grass-finished on pasture. Chicken feed is 'blended right on our farm', so category is pastured from the main poultry line; the lamb alone would be grass-finished. Contact page says the farm offers local deliveries and pick-up locations but names them only in the online store; visits by appointment only. No bulk shares, shipping, farmers markets or phone found. Not confirmed whether all animals are hatched or born on the farm.
